title: Sales tax registration
description: Federal sales tax on goods, and a note when the supply is services.

steps.title: Check which law applies
steps.title_ru: Dekhein kaun sa qanoon lagta hai
steps.detail: Sales tax on goods is under the Sales Tax Act, 1990, section 14. Sales tax on services is provincial.
steps.detail_ru: Goods par sales tax Sales Tax Act, 1990 ki section 14 ke tehat hai. Services par sales tax provincial hai.

steps.title: Federal registration on IRIS
steps.detail: Goods registration starts on IRIS. A services answer adds the provincial step after this one.
steps.detail_ru: Goods ki registration IRIS se shuru hoti hai. Services ka jawab is ke baad provincial step jodta hai.
